αἰνέω: (to tell;) to praise, approve, acquiesce in
διάκειμαι: to be in a certain state, to be disposed
κεῖμαι: to lie; to have been set/put (as perf. pass. of τίθημι)
μεθίημι: to let go, let loose, release
μεθίστημι: to place in another way, to change
παράφημι: to speak gently to, to advise
πείθω: to prevail upon, win over, persuade
πεινάω: to be hungry, suffer hunger, be famished
πρόσκειμαι: to be placed at, by; to be attached to, devoted to
σεύω: to put in quick motion: to drive, hunt, chase away
στεῦμαι: to make as if one would, to promise
σύνοιδα: to share in knowledge, be cognisant of
ἀνίστημι: to make to stand up, raise up
ἐξανίστημι: to raise up: to make one rise
ἐπέχω: to hold on; hold out; hold back; adjourn; occupy
ἐπίκειμαι: lie on, to be closed, to lie nearby (off the coast of)
ἐπισεύω: to put in motion against, set upon
ἐρύω: to drag along the ground, drag, draw
ἐφίστημι: to set on, over; set in charge of
ἔγκειμαι: to lie in, be wrapped in
ἡσσάομαι: to be less than another, inferior to
